title: 6 孙翔壁纸，被发现
slug: 全职高手首先你不会被一见钟情
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

周珈蓝拿着孙翔的手机，举起来自拍一张，给他换上当屏幕。

孙翔看了一眼，说：“好看，再拍几张。”

周珈蓝举着手机楞楞看着他。

孙翔已经掰着手指头数上了：“聊天背景，群聊背景，app背景，相册合集封面……”

他没数完，手机震了一下，孙翔低头看了一眼，眉头一皱。

时间到了，刚才那顿饭本来就是告别越云，他今晚的飞机飞h市，接手嘉世和神级账号卡一叶之秋。

“机场提醒候机，我走了。”孙翔说着说着眉眼又扬起来，这时候他相信的是此去鹏程万里，叶修落幕之后由他来铸就嘉世新的辉煌。

但是看着周珈蓝那张苍白漂亮的脸，将要说出口的话莫名拐了个弯。

她是妹妹。

她被那个……东西缠上了，她很惨很倒霉。

在她面前炫耀自己的幸运，是不是会刺痛她……？

“我等着阿茜娜站在我和一叶之秋面前的那一天！”

手机又开始震动，这下真是不得不走了，孙翔匆匆戴上口罩墨镜鸭舌帽，走之前又看向周珈蓝，“那个，呃……有事给我打电话，妹妹拜拜。”

周珈蓝看着他，眼睛明澈像镜子，“哥哥，拜拜。”

孙翔走了。

周珈蓝低头，慢条斯理地整理了一下沾血的裙摆。

然后她走进洗手间，站在镜子前。

半透明虚拟屏幕哗啦一声展开，环绕在她身边，莹绿色光泽照进她眼睛里，淡紫近粉的眼瞳被光屏照得像是绿色。

镜子里倒映出她的脸，雪白长发簇拥下，小小的雪白的脸，绿色的眼睛，不像活人，像个鬼魂，或者ai智能体。

孙翔如果看见她这时候这个模样会吓一跳，不带一点讨好的活人气，可是又那么漂亮，她还没来得及犯错，你已经忍不住宽恕她。

周珈蓝对着镜子笑了一下，细声细气道，“我们的任务我做完了，之后我也都会好好做完。”

“任务目标很容易心软，是好人。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Zhou Jialan took Sun Xiang's cell phone, raised it to take a selfie, and put it on his screen.

Sun Xiang took one look and said, "It looks good. Let's take some more pictures."

Zhou Jialan held up the phone and looked at him blankly.

Sun Xiang has already counted them on his fingers: "Chat background, group chat background, app background, photo album cover..."

Before he could finish counting, his phone vibrated. Sun Xiang looked down and frowned.

The time has come. The meal just now was meant to say goodbye to Yue Yun. He will fly to City H tonight to take over Excellent Era and the god-level account card One Autumn Leaf.

"Airport reminder to wait for the flight, I'm leaving." Sun Xiang raised his eyebrows as he spoke. At this time, he believed that he had a long journey ahead of him, and that after Ye Xiu came to an end, he would create a new glory for Excellent Era.

But looking at Zhou Jialan's pale and beautiful face, the words he was about to say took an inexplicable turn.

She is the younger sister.

She was entangled with that... thing, and she was miserable and unlucky.

Would it hurt to show off my luck in front of her...?

"I'm waiting for the day when Athena stands in front of One Autumn Leaf and me!"

The phone started to vibrate again, and now he really had to leave. Sun Xiang hurriedly put on his mask, sunglasses and cap. Before leaving, he looked at Zhou Jialan again, "Well, uh... call me if you need anything. Bye, sister."

Zhou Jialan looked at him, his eyes as clear as mirrors, "Brother, bye."

Sun Xiang left.

Zhou Jialan lowered his head and slowly adjusted the bloody skirt.

Then she went into the bathroom and stood in front of the mirror.

The translucent virtual screen unfolded with a crash and surrounded her. A bright green light shone into her eyes, and her lavender-to-pink pupils were illuminated by the light screen as if they were green.

Her face was reflected in the mirror. Surrounded by long snow-white hair, her small snow-white face and green eyes did not look like a living person, like a ghost, or an AI agent.

Sun Xiang would be frightened if he saw her like this. She doesn't have any flattering personality, but she is so beautiful. You can't help but forgive her before she can make a mistake.

Zhou Jialan smiled in the mirror and said softly, "I have completed our task, and I will complete it well in the future."

"The mission target is easily soft-hearted and a good person."
